program:
procedure SalonFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new client, then follow up once"
  policy SalonPolicy
  sheet Clients "Clients" { name: Text, phone: Phone, last_visit: Date, status: Text, tab: Money, color_formula: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Clients

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.name default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the salon! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Clients
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "lapsed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.name default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}
